name: Lust
source:
A curse plagues the land. This curse causes those who let their sexual desires get out of control to turn into Deviants. Some are able to harness the curse's energy. A power they call, Lust. Use this power to discover the mysteries of the curse. Join up or seduce characters onto your team.

[From [url=https://uncommonbreedvn.itch.io/lust]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场诅咒蔓延于这片土地。任由性欲失控的人，会在诅咒的作用下变成异变者。有些人却能驾驭诅咒中的能量，将这种力量称为“欲望”。运用这份力量，揭开诅咒背后的秘密，并通过结盟或诱惑，将各路角色招入队伍。

[摘自[url=https://uncommonbreedvn.itch.io/lust]Itch.io[/url]]
